sentences.text:
ASEMR POLICE STATION RAMNAGAR TEHSIL KOTMA  DISTRICT ANUPPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SHAILENDRA SINGH - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION RAMNAGAR DISTRICT ANUPPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY MS. NUPUR DHAMIJA - PANEL LAWYER )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.197/2022 dated21.6.2023, registered at Police Station Ramnagar,
District Anuppur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 450, 366, 376, 376(D), 506 Part II of IPC.
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant- Monu Yadav is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, as prayed by learned counsel, applicant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for bail after receipt of DNA report and prosecutrix evidence before the trial Court.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Monu Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13299589/
